items.prompt: During a practical, Sample F1-01 has these results: iodine blue-black; heated Benedict's green precipitate; Biuret lilac; ethanol emulsion test cloudy white emulsion. Which option gives the complete list of nutrient groups detected by these four tests?

optionReasons.reason: Incorrectly omits starch, which the stated iodine result detects.
Includes all and only the nutrient groups detected by the four stated observations.
Incorrectly omits protein, which the stated Biuret result detects.
Incorrectly omits lipid, which the stated ethanol emulsion result detects.
